sources.title: DeepSeek API change log: July 31 release and subsequent alias lifecycle
sources.evidence: The dated July 31 entry explicitly names DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, states that the preview architecture and size are retained with new post-training, and announces the updated API. September 10 retires V4 Flash and redirects its API alias to V4.1 Flash; October 17 updates that successor again.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies this exact release as the successor to the preview, reports improved agent benchmarks, and specifies the same structure as Flash-DSpark with an attached speculative decoding module. Documents thinking effort, local serving and MIT-licensed weights.

sources.title: Pinned DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model configuration
sources.evidence: Defines DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 43 main layers, hidden size 4096, 256 routed experts with top-6 selection and one shared expert, FP4 experts, DSpark settings, and max_position_embeddings 1048576. The num_nextn_predict_layers value is 1, inconsistent with the three actual DSpark stages in the inference configuration and tensor headers.

sources.title: Pinned 0731 inference configuration
sources.evidence: Explicitly configures 43 main layers and n_mtp_layers=3 for the DSpark attachment, block size 5 and target layers 40/41/42. Matches the three mtp.* namespaces in the released weights.

sources.title: Official 0731 inference implementation
sources.evidence: Shows decoder Transformer/MoE blocks and a three-stage DSpark draft stored under mtp.*, sharing the main embedding/output head. FP4 Linear stores two logical weights per packed element; quantization scales are separate. Fixed token-to-expert maps have requires_grad=False; learned hyper-connection scales and parameterized gate biases are retained.

sources.title: Official 0731 FP4 conversion
sources.evidence: Unpacks each I8 expert matrix element into two FP4 values from its low/high nibbles and reconstructs values with separate block scales. Shared MTP embedding/head duplicates are skipped by conversion.

sources.title: Pinned 0731 index and all 48 bounded safetensors headers
sources.evidence: All 72317 indexed tensors matched all 48 shard headers; 7998896 header bytes read, zero weight payload. Raw elements 165265454782 include 148176371712 packed FP4 elements, 9261408000 quantization scales and 2327040 fixed routing indices. Expanded logical count excluding scales/indices is 304178091454: 284332240471 main plus 19845850983 DSpark. No duplicated main embedding/head tensors occur under mtp.*.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4 technical report
sources.evidence: The Flash-specific preview configuration reports nominal 284B total/13B activated and million-token context. Describes DeepSeekMoE, hybrid compressed sparse/heavily compressed attention and manifold-constrained hyper-connections. FP4 quantization-aware training maintains FP32 master weights, supporting exclusion of representation scales from logical weight counts. Applied to 0731 core only via the explicit same-architecture/size statement.

sources.title: Pinned 0731 text, reasoning and tool encoding
sources.evidence: Defines text-message encoding and text-output parsing, chat/thinking modes with interleaved reasoning, and DSML tool invocation and tool-result schemas.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 MIT license
sources.evidence: MIT license text; the exact model card explicitly applies it to both repository and model weights.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release, April 24, 2026
sources.evidence: Original preview announcement reports Flash at 284B total, 13B activated and 1M context. Establishes the predecessor specifications explicitly retained in the July 31 core update; this April date is not the release date of 0731.

name.note: Display punctuation normalized from the exact official DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 identifier.

developer.note: Published by the official DeepSeek organization and documentation site.

family.note: Retains the catalog family key for the DeepSeek Flash line; this dated checkpoint is V4, not the later V4.1 API alias target.

release_date.note: Explicit dated official API release entry names this exact 0731 variant. April 24 is the earlier preview release.

open_weights.note: Public exact-variant checkpoint accessed at a pinned revision; all indexed tensor headers verified.

license.note: Exact model card explicitly licenses both the repository and model weights under MIT.

parameters_b.note: Complete logical checkpoint count: 284.332240471B main + 19.845850983B unique DSpark parameters. Expands each packed FP4 byte to two logical weights and excludes quantization scales/fixed routing indices, while retaining learned hyper-connection scales and parameterized gate biases. Shared main embedding/head counted once. Nominal 284B and same-size language concern the core model, not the full DSpark-bearing checkpoint.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal main-model activation per token, supported for 0731 by the explicit same-architecture/size statement. It is not an exact count or the combined work of main verification and DSpark drafting.

architecture.note: Decoder Transformer with DeepSeekMoE, CSA/HCA hybrid attention and mHC; 43 main blocks with 256 routed experts/top-6 plus one shared expert. Includes three separate DSpark stages under mtp.*. Root num_nextn_predict_layers=1 is stale/inconsistent with inference n_mtp_layers=3 and actual headers; the latter agree.

context_window.note: Retains advertised 1M context of the unchanged V4 Flash architecture. Exact 0731 configuration supports 1048576 positions; positional ceiling is distinguished from the advertised decimal window.

modalities.note: Exact checkpoint and encoder implement text tokens without a visual encoder. The separately announced August Vision Exp and September V4.1 models do not establish visual input for 0731.

reasoning.note: Exact release documents low/high/max reasoning effort and thinking/chat prompt encoding.

tool_call.note: Exact repository documents DSML tool calls and tool-result handling, including interleaved thinking.

description.value: Official DeepSeek V4 Flash release with enhanced agentic capabilities and integrated DSpark speculative decoding
description.note: Baseline description is supported by the exact model card and attached DSpark implementation; enhanced refers to the published comparisons against the preview.

patch.notes: July 31, 2026 dated V4 Flash release. Core advertised 284B/13B architecture is retained from the April preview, with new post-training and a DSpark attachment. Complete logical weights total 304.178091454B: 284.332240471B main plus 19.845850983B unique DSpark; packed FP4 values are expanded, quantization scales/fixed routing indices excluded, and shared embeddings/head counted once. Nominal 13B active applies to main model only. Actual weights and inference configuration contain three DSpark stages, despite root config num_nextn_predict_layers=1. Advertised context is 1M; configured positional ceiling is 1048576. The September 10 redirect of deepseek-v4-flash to V4.1 Flash and October 17 successor update do not change this checkpoint identity. No endpoint execution was tested.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for exact July 31 0731 weights. Added MoE architecture, complete 304.178091454B logical parameters and nominal 13B main-model active parameters. Independently inspected every shard header and reconciled the DSpark attachment, FP4 packing, excluded metadata and shared weights. Preserved release date, MIT, advertised 1M text context, reasoning/tools and supported description; documented config-stage discrepancy and later API alias routing.
